title: Eventual Fourier weight of the modified function
statement: For all sufficiently large integers $q$, the level-one Fourier weight of the real-valued version of the Boolean function obtained by using the small-set indicator on the tail coordinates and otherwise returning the first coordinate is at least $1-\Delta_q+\frac{1}{36}\Delta_q^2\log(1/\Delta_q)$, where $\Delta_q$ is twice the uniform mass of the small set.
